ns2:section.sectionText: 3 hours Topic: Balkans and Middle East in Comparative Perspective. Examines relations among countries in the Eastern Mediterranean and addresses the political and cultural influence of Western Europe and the European Union in this area. Focus on foreign policy, history, culture and society of countries in the Balkan Peninsula and the Middle East (Greece, Turkey, Israel, Egypt, the successor states of the former Yugoslavia). Meets withGRKM 199A (CRN 54918) and PS 199 (CRN 53030).
